meta.title: Mia's Fact File: The Sun Bear
meta.textType: functional: an animal fact file with headings, a blog post

paragraphs: Posted by Mia. On Wednesday, February seventeenth, I wrote a fact file about my favorite bear, the sun bear. I love animals, and I want to study biology one day. Lily sat beside me, because she checks every post for our blog. My file has a photo of a sun bear and three headings. The headings are Food, Looks, and Home. The sun bear is the smallest bear in the world. Please read my file, and then tell me your favorite fact.

Food. The sun bear eats honey, insects, and various kinds of fruit. Its tongue is very long, so it can get honey from inside a tree. The sun bear is an excellent climber. Climbing is easy for it, because its claws are curved. It climbs a lot every day to find food.

Looks. A sun bear has short black fur and a pale yellow mark on its chest. Some people say that the mark looks like the morning sun. That is why the animal is called a sun bear. Its tongue is about twenty-five centimeters long. Its claws are long and curved. The bear is only about as big as a large dog. In my notebook, I drew a sun bear and wrote three notes. My notes say "long tongue," "curved claws," and "pale chest mark." Next to my drawing, I put a small ruler for the tongue.

Home. The sun bear lives in the rainforests of Southeast Asia, including Thailand. It likes an area with many tall trees, because it needs food and a safe place to sleep. It sleeps in a nest of sticks and leaves, and the nest is built high in a tree. Sometimes the bear rests there after a big meal. Many rainforests are cut down every year, and that is sad. Then the sun bear has no home and no food. The rainforest is hot and wet, and its trees are very tall. The sun bear is a protected animal, so people cannot hurt it. Wildlife workers look after the bears and their forest home.

Did you know that a newborn cub has a weight of only about three hundred grams? That is very small for a bear. P.S. Nadia writes to me from Singapore, and she asked me about bears. This file is for her. Nadia, which animal is your favorite? Please write to me about your favorite animal.
